https://www.dw.com/en/drc-ebola-outbreak.text: Skip to content Skip to main menu Skip to more DW sites https://p.dw.com/p/5Iw7M Medical personnel treating Ebola patients need protective clothing Image: Xinhua/dpa/picture alliance Advertisement An Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has now killed 2,325 people, surpassing a previous record toll of 2,299 from an outbreak in 2018-2020, government figures showed on Monday. The deaths were from 4,945 confirmed cases of the disease, which is transmitted via infected bodily fluids and can cause fever, vomiting, diarrhea and, in severe cases, internal and external bleeding. The United Nations says the outbreak "is the fastest growing on record" and is killing a victim every half an hour in the DRC. The outbreak is now second in lethality only to one in West Africa in 2014-2016. At that time, 28,616 cases and 11,310 deaths were recorded across Guinea, Liberia and Sierra ​Leone, according ‌to the World Health Organization. The nurse in DR Congo battling Ebola To view this video please enable JavaScript, and consider upgrading to a web browser that supports HTML5 video How has the Ebola outbreak spread in DRC? The current outbreak, DRC's 17th, ‌is caused by the Bundibugyo species of Ebola. There are no approved vaccines or treatments for the disease. The outbreak, which was declared on May 15, began — probably several weeks earlier — in northeastern Ituri province and has now spread to five more provinces. New treatment centers have been set up in DRC, as shown here in North Kivu province Image: Xinhua/picture alliance High rate of fatalities The case fatality ratio — the proportion of deaths following a confirmed infection — has risen from some 20% in early June to 46% now, government data has shown. That means that nearly one in two confirmed cases ends in death. Experts say this rise does not suggest that the virus has become more lethal but instead reflects deficiencies in surveillance, detection and access to care. The disease has killed more than 15,000 people in Africa over the past 50 years. Beállítom “Anita Orbán met with her Ukrainian counterpart on several occasions during the UN High-Level Week, and they were able to clear up the misunderstandings of the past few days,” the Hungarian Ministry of Foreign Affairs wrote in a Facebook post , reporting on developments at the UN General Assembly taking place in New York. The Minister of Foreign Affairs is in constant contact with the Ukrainian Deputy Prime Minister about issues affecting the rights of the Hungarian community in Transcarpathia, with further developments expected on the matter in October, they said. They added that Hungary is open to new regional cooperation initiatives, but wants to have a clear understanding of their objectives, how they operate, and what added value they bring to Hungary. The statement also notes that the administration is engaged in intensive consultations with the United States, including on matters of energy security. The sanctions from which Hungary previously received a one-year exemption are also on the agenda, with efforts to have the Americans extend this exemption already underway. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky recently announced the launch of a regional initiative, the Carpathian Eight, and said that Hungary would be participating. It soon became clear, however, that this was not the case, which Hungarian Prime Minister Péter Magyar also pointed out in a comment under the Ukrainian Foreign Minister's post. We discussed the matter in detail in a previous article. For more quick, accurate and impartial news from and about Hungary, subscribe to the Telex English newsletter! https://www.politico.eu/article/us-speci.text: Steve Witkoff, the United States’ special envoy, praised Russian ruler Vladimir Putin during face-to-face talks in St. Petersburg, calling him “a humanitarian.” “You talk so much about my president, President Trump, being a humanitarian. You are a humanitarian also, sir, and I salute that, I commend you, and I thank you again,” Witkoff said Wednesday in a Russian state media video clip posted on social media . Witkoff’s visit is the latest U.S. attempt to bring Moscow and Kyiv to the negotiation table, four-and-a-half years after the Kremlin launched its full-scale invasion of Ukraine. Advertisement Advertisement The American envoy met Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy in Oslo on Tuesday, and is expected to propose trilateral talks between the two leaders and U.S. President Donald Trump. Russia’s strikes on Kyiv and Kharkiv continued overnight, killing three people, local mayors reported . Putin’s assault on Ukraine killed 328 civilians in September alone, according to the United Nations , while Kremlin forces bombard energy infrastructure across the country heading into winter. The International Criminal Court issued an arrest warrant for Putin in 2023 over the forced transfer of children to Russia after the Kremlin’s invasion of Ukraine began.

Photograph: Guy Corbishley/Alamy View image in fullscreen Jack Ross at a London vigil after the murder of Charlie Kirk. He told Al Jazeera that his comments to its undercover reporter were not serious. Photograph: Guy Corbishley/Alamy Conservatives Former Tory election candidate suspended over contract killing claims Jack Ross was filmed allegedly discussing with an undercover reporter violent options to deal with enemies Ben Quinn and Henry Dyer Wed 21 Oct 2026 14.13 EDT Last modified on Wed 21 Oct 2026 15.09 EDT Share Prefer the Guardian on Google A former Conservative election candidate has been suspended from the party after he was seemingly filmed discussing the cost of hiring contract killers and offering to “broker” the services of a far-right activist with alleged paramilitary links. Jack Ross was filmed apparently asking an undercover reporter “What do you want done?” before listing the type of violent options that could be bought. Ross appeared to tell the Al Jazeera journalist: “They can just kick the fuck out of someone. That’s a certain amount. They can start cutting people’s faces up, that’s another amount. And they can stab someone. They can shoot someone. They can kill someone.” Police in Scotland say they will be reviewing and assessing the Al Jazeera documentary – Contract Killers and the Far Right – for any criminality. Ross is the chief executive of Turning Point UK, a spin-off from the campaign group founded by the murdered US Republican commentator Charlie Kirk. Footage released by TPUK last year showed Ross and others from the group meeting Kemi Badenoch, the Tory leader, after Kirk’s death. A profile page for Ross on the website of the Bow Group, a Conservative thinktank that lists him as a research fellow, states he has advised MPs and candidates on political and digital strategy. He has been pictured alongside Boris Johnson and other high-profile figures including James Cleverly, Jacob Rees-Mogg and Liam Fox. Ross was reported by Al Jazeera to have introduced an undercover reporter to a violent criminal from Glasgow with links to the paramilitary Ulster Volunteer Force, who offers to have people killed for money. Al Jazeera approached Ross with a fictitious family problem where a deceased uncle’s business was at risk of being taken over by a gang, whose members were supposedly warned they would “get fucked” if anything happened. Ross replied to this: “Yeah, you have to deliver on that as well. You’ve got to explain to me what’s needed … I can then go and broker from there. But I’ve got to say, even to myself … if there’s lashback I’ve got to keep my name out of it.” The Scottish paramilitary contact was then filmed at a London hotel offering to arrange different types of killings, ranging from a hit-and-run that could be made to look like drink-driving to a stabbing. The meeting took place after Ross, apparently acting on behalf of the Zimbabwean government, had reportedly paid thousands of pounds to the Glasgow activist to organise a fake political rally in support of lifting UK sanctions imposed on the African country. Ross said: “I have had a few things and some of the Zims [Zimbabweans] have said to me they want stuff done. They wanted a fucking shooter.” He said he had asked them to talk to the paramilitary, adding: “I said I was not putting fucking prints on anything.” While TPUK was launched as a student movement, it has become increasingly involved in anti-migrant street protests. Its chief operating officer is Nick Tenconi, the leader of the far-right UK Independence party, who visited the Conservative conference in 2022 with Ross. Ross was filmed in 2022 telling an undercover reporter they should chat to him about what they wanted, adding “keep it simple” and then listing the various violent options that could be bought for cash, including murder. skip past newsletter promotion Free newsletter | Every day Sign up to Headlines UK Get the day’s headlines and highlights emailed direct to you every morning after newsletter promotion A Conservative party spokesperson said: “Mr Ross’s membership of the Conservative party has been suspended with immediate effect pending an investigation. We cannot comment further while the investigation is ongoing.” At another point, Ross expressed concerns that journalists could be recording the sort of things he was saying and could pass them to police. “The journalist will put it out there and then the police will pick it up and fuck you,” he said. “You’ve got to think that what we were talking about and had someone film it we’d be fucking done for conspiracy.” Tenconi was filmed alongside Ross as they outlined a plan to use football hooligans to stir up trouble. Tenconi said: “So let Labour get in. So we build the new right and we have these armies … so, three-pronged. We keep winning MPs over. Then we build the second prong, we build an army, and that’s street demos, protest, just fuck things up, basically.” A Police Scotland spokesperson said: “We’re aware of the documentary. It will be reviewed and assessed for any criminality.” Al Jazeera reported that Ross had “completely” denied its investigation’s findings, claiming that everything he said to the undercover reporter was not meant seriously. Ross, who was a local elections candidate for the Conservatives , was approached by the Guardian for comment through TPUK. Tenconi was also approached for comment via his party. https://hvg.hu/vilag/20261109_eddig-400-.text: Az orosz statisztikai hivatal által kiállított közel négyszázezer halotti bizonyítvány vélhetően csak egy része a teljes veszteségnek. A fehérorosz Cyber Partisans hacker aktivista csoport és az ukrán Silent Crow hackercsapat olyan titkosított adatbázist szerzett meg az orosz statisztikai hivataltól, a Rosstattól, amelyből kiderülnek az Ukrajna ellen indított háború emberi veszteségei. Az adatbázis alapján a 2022-ben indított offenzíva óta 392 700 olyan halotti bizonyítványt állítottak ki, ami konkrétan a háborúhoz köthető, azonban a szám nagyobb is lehet, hiszen a statisztikában nem jelennek meg azok, akiket egyelőre csak eltűntként tartanak nyilván. Fontos – hívja fel a figyelmet a Cyber Partisans –, hogy a halotti bizonyítványok nem tükrözik a teljes orosz veszteséget, hiszen a harcokban eltűntek mellett nem jeleníti meg a sebesülteket és a maradandó egészségkárosodást szenvedőket sem. A Cyber Partisans számítása alapján a teljes szám akár ötszöröse is lehet az igazolt halálesetek számának, így akár 2 millió fős veszteségről is beszélhetünk elméletben. A két hackercsoport saját oldalukon közzétette, illetve pár híroldalnak is elküldte az adatokat, köztük a Bloomberg nek is. Az utóbbi pedig megkereste a Rosstatot, a hivatal azonban nem válaszolt a lap megkeresésére. Az adatszivárgás azért is érdekes, mert az ukrán elnök, Volodimir Zelenszkij úgy nyilatkozott, hogy októberben rekordveszteséget szenvedtek el az oroszok, eszerint volt, hogy egy nap alatt 2250 főt vesztettek el, miközben az október végi tűzszünetet kihasználva fegyvereket csempésztek az oleski területére . A november 18-19-én tartott Ázsiai-Csendes-óceáni Gazdasági Együttműködés (APEC) csúcstalálkozón Putyin Hszi Csin-pinggel és Trumppal tárgyalhat egy háromoldalú egyeztetés során, ahol Putyin akár az ukrajnai háború rendezésének a kérdését is megvitatná. Képünk illusztráció, egy Kijevben kiállított orosz tankot ábrázol. Fotó: AFP / Sergey Supnski Budapesten és Pest megyében több helyszínen zajlanak elfogások és házkutatások egy embercsempész ügyben.
